daily.topThemeTitle: AI's Story Turns From Adoption to Governance
daily.topThemeBody: EdTech Digest argues the sector is moving past adoption into stewardship — governance, oversight, and long-term responsibility for how AI tools get used, a theme echoed across recent EdTech Digest and Brookings coverage.
